lessons.title: Factorial Design Fundamentals: Notation & Levels
lessons.description: Decode factorial notation (2x2, 2x3), factors and levels, and contrast between, within, and mixed factorial matrices.

lessons.title: Main Effects vs. Interaction Effects
lessons.description: Calculate marginal means, detect crossover and spreading interactions, and learn why interactions supersede main effects.

lessons.title: Quasi-Experimental Designs: When Random Assignment Is Impossible
lessons.description: Navigate nonequivalent control groups, interrupted time-series designs, regression discontinuity, and selection confounds.

lessons.title: Small-N & Single-Case Experimental Designs
lessons.description: Explore rigorous experimental logic in individual subjects: ABAB reversal designs and multiple-baseline designs across behaviors and settings.
